info.about: Sword Art Online: Hollow Realization is a Japanese video game developed by Aquria and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment for the PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, and Windows PC, based on the Japanese light novel series, Sword Art Online. It is the fourth video game in the series and the successor to Sword Art Online: Lost Song.
info.trivia: The Vita version was sold in North America only as a download; the PS4 disc was the physical release.
info.why: No US Vita disc exists, so physical copies are European or Asian imports.
